## Walkthrough

This PR refactors the second-pass queue implementation in the cache manager by extracting a repeated workload key expression into a local variable and updating test cases to validate eviction scenarios with a simplified test structure.

## Changes

**Second-Pass Queue Cleanup**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Implementation cleanup in QueueSecondPassIfNeeded** <br> `pkg/cache/queue/manager.go` | Local `wlKey` variable is extracted and reused in log messages instead of calling `workload.Key(w)` inline; issue comment reference updated from `#8357` to full GitHub URL. |
| **Test refactoring and eviction scenarios** <br> `pkg/cache/queue/manager_test.go` | Test case struct refactored from `update func(*kueue.Workload)` callback to `updateWorkload *kueue.Workload` pointer field; new eviction-focused test cases validate readiness outcomes when workloads are evicted before second-pass queue processing. |

## Estimated Code Review Effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
